en: A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a barren, rocky landscape with rugged mountains in the background and a few isolated low white buildings in the middle distance. The terrain looks dry and volcanic. The printed captions read "Lazareto" on the upper left and "S. Vicente C. V." on the upper right, indicating the lazaretto (quarantine station) area on the island of São Vicente.
